title: Prompt Codebooks: Discrete Compositional Optimization for Language Model Instruction Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2605.28360v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Automatic prompt optimization (APO) has driven significant gains in LLM-based agentic workflows. However, most existing methods treat each task's prompt as a monolithic, instance-blind string optimized through global edits, producing brittle updates and preventing the reuse of learned sub-behaviors. We propose Prompt Codebook Optimization (PCO), a novel compositional prompt optimization framework that recasts APO as discrete learning over a finite vocabulary of natural-language instincts--atomic, reusable instruction units. PCO organizes prompt-construction knowledge in a discrete codebook and routes each input to a small subset of entries via an LLM-based encoder; a generator composes them into a prompt for the executor; a critic emits a structured verdict that decomposes by attribution into per-variable textual gradients, jointly training the encoder, generator, critic, and codebook under a language-valued min-max objective. translated_title: 提示词码本：面向语言模型指令精炼的离散组合优化
translated_abstract: 自动提示词优化（APO）已在基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体工作流中带来了显著提升。然而，大多数现有方法将每个任务的提示词视为一个单一的、与具体实例无关的字符串，并通过全局编辑进行优化，这导致更新脆弱，且无法复用已学习的子行为。我们提出提示词码本优化（PCO），这是一种新颖的组合式提示词优化框架，它将APO重新表述为对有限的自然语言“直觉”词表——即原子化、可复用的指令单元——进行的离散学习。PCO将提示词构建知识组织在一个离散码本中，并通过基于LLM的编码器将每个输入路由到少量码本条目；生成器将这些条目组合成供执行器使用的提示词；评论家给出结构化判定，并通过归因分解为每个变量的文本梯度，从而在语言值的极小极大目标下联合训练编码器、生成器、评论家和码本。
tldr: 该论文提出提示词码本优化（PCO）框架，将自动提示词优化重新建模为对可复用自然语言指令单元码本的离散组合学习，通过编码器—生成器—评论家架构和文本梯度信号实现提示词的模块化构建与各组件的联合优化。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Prompt Codebook Optimization (PCO), which reformulates automatic prompt optimization as discrete compositional learning over a codebook of atomic, reusable natural-language instruction units, employing an encoder-generator-critic architecture with textual gradients for joint modular prompt refinement.
